name: Worried
overview: Scripture addresses the burden of worry by encouraging believers to trust in God's provision and care. Proverbs 12:25 highlights how heaviness and anxiety weigh down the heart, yet a kind word can bring joy and relief. Jesus teaches in Matthew 6:25 that life is more valuable than material needs, urging believers not to be anxious about daily necessities. Philippians 4:6 further instructs Christians to replace worry with prayer and thanksgiving, presenting their concerns to God with confidence rather than fear.
